answer: Proof-of-stake serves as the kernel of identity validation in an agent economy, preventing Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment. Like a river of value flowing through staked assets, this mechanism forces an attacker to purchase prohibitive amounts of tokens to gain influence. By anchoring voting weight to financial exposure, the system ensures that spinning up a lotus of fake identities remains economically irrational, as the cost of capital scales linearly with requested network control.
